benchmark_selection_rules: Treat these as comparative market baselines, not automatically as donor platforms or engineering targets.
Acquire three written quotes per candidate/grade where practical and preserve date/expiry/condition.
Verify the exact variant and applicable safety/homologation evidence before comparing utility.
Use the same declared annual distance, passenger/payload distribution, trip mix, terrain, climate, energy-price date and ownership horizon across candidates.
Measure routine maintenance tasks and parts lead times; do not infer serviceability from purchase price or warranty duration.
Add used-vehicle comparators only after condition, odometer, service history, inspection, ownership costs and parts-risk are documented.
A low advertised starting price is not equivalent to lowest 10-year cost or adequate family utility.
For a South African manufacturing scenario, screen meaningful local value-add and SKD/APDP2 policy exposure using official policy sources; treat this as a risk scenario, not legal eligibility advice.
claim_ceiling: Prices are online advertised-from snapshots retrieved 2026-10-17, not verified dealer quotations.
Only the Swift entry has an initial specification screen here; exact variant data for every candidate still needs capture.
No cost-of-ownership, reliability, safety superiority or repairability result has been established.
